register.labelZh: SMELL AND SMILE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: SMELL AND SMILE Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: smell of 能幫助你說明某人、房間、衣物或物件帶有甚麼氣味。；smell out 可以描述動物憑氣味找出事物,也可以描述某人察覺弱點、把戲、謊言或麻煩。；當食物、垃圾、鞋子或油漆令房間、汽車或房屋充滿濃烈氣味時,可以使用 smell something out。；smile on 或 smile upon 可以表示好運、命運、生活或天氣眷顧某人。
register.summaryEn: Smell of helps you say what kind of smell a person, room, piece of clothing or object has. Smell out can describe a dog finding something by scent. It can also describe a person noticing weakness, a trick, a lie or trouble. You can use smell something out when food, rubbish, shoes or paint makes a room, car or house smell strongly. Smile on or smile upon can show that luck, fate, life or the weather is favourable to someone.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. The two uses of smell something out are different: The dog smelt out the food. That fish smelt the kitchen out. Smile on and smile upon can express the same meaning.
